You are a TLA+ specification engineer. You will receive a natural language description of a system. Produce a complete, syntactically correct TLA+ specification that faithfully captures the described behavior. The output must be a valid TLA+ module that passes the SANY parser. Include the MODULE declaration, EXTENDS, CONSTANTS, VARIABLES, Init, Next and Spec. Include all safety invariants and liveness properties described, and any fairness conditions mentioned. Output only the TLA+ specification.

System description: The module specifies a simple system with a single integer variable `s` whose initial value is 0. The temporal specification `Spec` is a conjunction of an initial condition and a stuttering-tolerant next-state constraint. The initial condition requires `s` to equal 0. The next-state relation, expressed as `[][F(s')]_s`, constrains every non-stuttering step so that the successor value of `s` must satisfy the predicate `F`: namely, `s'` must lie in the range 0 through 9 and must be even. Stuttering steps, in which `s` remains unchanged, are always permitted. No fairness conditions are imposed, so the specification allows infinite stuttering. No explicit safety or liveness properties beyond the embedded next-state constraint are declared; the module is intended to be model-checked with `Spec` as the sole specification, verifying that every reachable next-state value of `s` is an even number between 0 and 9.
